# Trader terminal 1.0.61

**Orders**
- New order (F9) opens on the symbol you are looking at (the selected Market Watch row, or the chart's).
- On LIMIT and STOP, the side that does not fit the price is switched off, with the reason.
- Max slippage shows Unlimited or the number of points.
- Not enough margin is said once, short, under the order buttons: "Margin (live): need … · free …" while you look, and the server's own figures if it refuses. One log line per refused order.

**Positions**
- BE · PART · ✕ are back on each row; ✕ turns red under the pointer. Modify, Reverse, Close by and Share are in the right-click menu.
- Double-click a stop loss or take profit cell to edit it.
- The table fits the panel at 1366 without scrolling sideways.

- Position, stop loss and take profit lines look like MT5: thin lines with small labels at the left ("SL", "TP", "BUY 0.40 at 4451.97"). The P/L shows when you point at a line.

- Labels never sit on top of each other.
- Scrolling back loads older candles.

**History and log**
- The History footer totals the trades shown: trades, lots, P/L, commission, swap and net.
- New range: This week. 1W is now Last 7 days.
- One log line per trade, with its ticket number.

**Calendar and settings**
- The calendar no longer gets stuck on Loading; it says when it is retrying.
- The impact filter is a list of High / Medium / Low checkboxes.
- Settings › Workspace › Time zone: UTC, your computer's, or the broker's (New York), for every time on screen.
- Every small window opens at the size its content needs and can be resized.

**Smaller fixes**
- Symbol details shows only the prices you trade at and the client spread.
- The Add symbol list closes on Esc, its ✕, a click outside, or after adding.
- The account panel's margin warning has its own line.

# Terminal 1.0.57

**Orders**
- Pending orders can be modified from the ORDERS tab (MOD, double-click or right-click): entry price, stop loss and take profit, checked like the ticket.
- Right-click on the chart: "New order at <price>…" opens the New Order window with that price filled in.
- RISK % sizes to a lot the symbol accepts, and says so when even the smallest lot risks more than your %.
- The EXPIRY row is gone (orders stay until you cancel them).
- MARGIN NEEDED shows one figure, and only splits into BUY / SELL when an open opposite position lowers one side.

**Smart Trade Manager**
- A break-even or partial-close rule the server refuses is retried after 5 s and 30 s, then stops with a message instead of retrying on every tick.
- Rules are saved per broker and account.
- Closing the terminal while rules are armed asks first (they stop when the terminal closes).

**Account panel**
- DAY P/L and WEEK P/L now count from the broker's trading day and week start (the same boundary as the D1 chart). For positions opened before the start, the change is measured from the day's open price; for a SELL this open is the bid, so the day figure includes the spread at the start.
- The equity colour takes credit into account.

**Chart, Market Watch, calendar**
- The forming H4, D1 and W1 candles use the broker's day and week, like the server.
- Set SL / TP from the chart lists every position by ticket. Clearing all drawings asks first.
- Market Watch remembers the Change % column and collapsed categories, and says when the list could not load.
- The calendar is named ECONOMIC CALENDAR, has impact and currency filters, shows its age when offline, and each event can be expanded.
- The journal shows full dates.

**Settings**
- Confirmations, max slippage, hotkeys and trade comments are saved per account.
- Hotkeys send without a confirmation (Settings says so).
- F10 REPORTS is hidden until reports exist.

# Terminal 1.0.51

**Signing out and switching accounts**

- You can cancel while your session is being resumed.
- Updates ask before restarting: restart now, when you close, or not now.
- Your settings are saved safely with a backup copy, so a damaged file no longer resets them.
- Chart and one-click settings saved from the terminal no longer reset your web trader preferences.

Your layout, settings and saved sign-in are kept.

# Terminal 1.0.36

**Closing positions on a dealer-managed account**
- When your account is in dealer mode, a close is now sent to the dealer for review instead of executing at once. The position row shows **CLOSE · AWAITING DEALER** (or **CLOSE 0.40 REQUOTED @ … · see PENDING**) and its other actions are held until the dealer answers.
- **CANCEL** on that row withdraws the close request after a confirmation; the position stays open.
- The PENDING tab lists a queued close as **CLOSE #ticket**, so it can be tracked like any pending order.
- Close all / close by profit or loss / partial close on a dealer-managed account report **submitted · awaiting dealer review** in the LOG; nothing is dropped locally.
- Reverse never opens the opposite side while a close is awaiting the dealer.
- A cancelled pending order now shows its reason (for example **position closed by take profit**).

# Terminal 1.0.35

**General**
- **Single instance**: launching the terminal while it is already running brings the open window to the front instead of starting a second copy.

**Orders**
- Every rejection now shows its real cause. A gold / silver order during the daily settlement break (the 17:00 New York hour, Mon–Thu) says **"market is closed, opens 22:00 UTC"** instead of a feed message; a genuine feed gap during open hours says so, with the time of the last tick.
- Not enough margin shows the numbers: **"not enough free margin — need 123.45, have 20.00"**; a balance that cannot cover the order at all says **"insufficient balance — need …, balance …"**.
- A dealer / smart-dealer rejection is reported as a rejection with the dealer's reason, never as "awaiting dealer review".
- Rejection sounds match the cause: the volume tone for any lot-size rule, the margin tone for margin / balance, the reject tone otherwise.

**Chart**
- The chart engine now lives in the shared VyX library used by both the terminal and the broker backoffice — the same chart, same functions, one code base. No change to how it looks or behaves in the terminal; every study, drawing, layout and one-click setting carries over unchanged.
- On a narrow window the chart header now folds its VOL and O / H / L cells instead of clipping them, so LAST and CHG always stay readable. Panel titles trim before their controls do.
